Definition: neuter of a compound of G1497 and a presumed derivative of G2380; an image-sacrifice, i.e. part of an idolatrous offering:--(meat, thing that is) offered (in sacrifice, sacrificed) to (unto) idols.
BiblicalUsage: This is meat that has been sacrificed to an idol, food that carries a history with it, and the New Testament argues about it more than any other food. Paul says knowledge about idols puffs up, but love builds up, and the council at Jerusalem tells Gentile believers to abstain from things offered to idols. Jesus rebukes the church at Pergamos for eating things sacrificed to idols, because the food had become fellowship with false gods.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the question is never only about the food, because what we eat together says who we belong to. Love decides the table, not knowledge, and I want my table to build up, not to trip up.
